notes.title: Hot Fix #4
notes.content:
Animals will only move if the player is within the area.

The option to disable seekers if SOS is off now disables seekers in houses too.

The stumps from cut trees will now be destroyed if a tree is cut.

Lootable items will now be highlighted in your surroundings

Fixed typo in Workbench

Fixed tree health remaining when chopped down

notes.title: Hot Fix #3
notes.content:
This update is focused on performance, and you will notice a great improvement in FPS. 

Added Metal scrap extra spawners near the airplane when you first start the game.

Added outline to metal scrap to easier spot them on the floor

notes.title: Hot Fix #2
notes.content:
- Added Outline to Plant Fiber for better visibility

- Increased Food decay timer

- Now only dropped food will decay, this way spawned food by the game will remain until picked up by the Player

- Increased Sticks drop rate to 4 when destroying Bush's

- Now it is possible to turn Logs into sticks by pressing dismantle

- You can now use Logs as fuel for campfire and furnace

- Added Extra Sticks and Stones when spawning for the first time in the game

- Fixed Option to disable Seekers spawning if SOS is off

- Berry will now spawn on proper bush's

- Fixed destroying sounds playing for all players when playing in multiplayer

notes.title: Hot Fix #1
notes.content:
- Fixed respawn inside plane
- Fixed Animals throwing you out of the map
- Increased drop rates for simple items such as sticks, stones, scrap, mushroom and berry
- Removed Cache from saving system

notes.title: Update v1.0 is out!
notes.content:
The Update 1.0 is a complete rework of the game.

It is important to mention.

Multiplayer Co-Op for two players (Soon we will allow for 4)

Controller Support

Multiple saves are now possible, you can now save up to four different slots.

Improved Character controller

To give a better game feel, guns and melee weapons have been improved.

New Inventory System and UI Interactions

Added villages containing loot

And many more..

[previewyoutube=z3QivX7Z33Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Small Update #5
notes.content:
- You can now craft Bolts for the Crossbow at the Workbench (Crossbow will one shot seekers if hit on Head or Chest)
- Fixed SOS signal randomly stop working when more than one Campfire is placed
- Changed Pistol description
- Fixed animals getting de-spawn when still in range
- Decreased luggage and military container spawn delay
- Decreased metal scrap spawn delay

The next update will be focused on content (still, I will try to fix any bug reported).
A roadmap will be posted soon with detailed information for the upcoming updates and what you can expect in the near future
